corrected_semantics.corrected_label: C0007 full_tests attested test-library compilation, not lake test execution
corrected_semantics.explanation: At C0007 acceptance the Lean CI workflow invoked leanprover/lean-action@v1 with build-args 'NumStability NumStabilityTest' and test: false. The green CI evidence therefore proves that the NumStabilityTest test library compiled at the accepted code; it does not prove that the literal command 'lake test' was executed by CI. Because lakefile.toml declares testDriver = 'NumStabilityTest' (a lean_lib), 'lake test' is semantically equivalent to building that library, so the compilation attestation is materially equivalent in outcome; this record corrects the label of what was executed, not the PASS outcome.
